title: Sebastian and the Parish
author: Sable Crane
blurb: Rosalind Nakamura, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
